description: Read back a value previously stored via memory_store, by exact (namespace, key) — lossless, includes metadata. Use when native Read is wrong because the value is not a file (it lives in the .swarm/memory.db SQLite store) AND you know the exact key. For semantic lookup by meaning, use memory_search.

agentId.description: Agent whose scoped memory to use; letters, digits, _ and - only. Required with scope, rejected without it.

dbPath.description: Explicit SQLite store to read/write; omit to use the MCP default (the native/AgentDB sibling).

scope.description: AgentMemoryScope (#1227): project (shared), local (this machine) or user (this user). Requires agentId. Partitions the store by prefixing the namespace as agent-memory:<scope>:<agentId>:<namespace>; omit for the unscoped namespace exactly as before.

name: memory_retrieve
